name: finora-ai
description: Finora AI — Your Money. Your Goals. One AI.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @finora/backend" "npm run dev -w @finora/frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @finora/shared && npm run build -w @finora/ai && npm run build -w @finora/backend && npm run build -w @finora/frontend
scripts.build:backend: npm run build -w @finora/shared && npm run build -w @finora/ai && npm run build -w @finora/backend
scripts.test: npm run test -w @finora/backend -- --runInBand && npm run test -w @finora/frontend -- --watch=false --browsers=ChromeHeadless
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @finora/backend && npm run lint -w @finora/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @finora/shared && npm run typecheck -w @finora/ai && npm run typecheck -w @finora/backend
